newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador to privatise of 49 percent of Petroecuador.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador to privatise of 49 percent of Petroecuador.

text.p: Ecuador will privatise 49 percent of state oil firm Petroecuador, Energy and Mines Minister Alfredo Adum said on Tuesday.
"The state will not lose control, it will retain 51 percent of all its petrol," Adum said after announcing the government's plans to sell a 49 percent stake in its oil firm.
The government would also privatise 49 percent of Ecuador's Electricity Institute, Adum added.
Last Sunday Ecuadorean President Abdala Bucaram unveiled a comprehensive economic reform programme and said he planned to privatise most state firms.
He said Ecuador would raise some $5.0 billion over the next two years by privatising its largest state-run companies.
